title: 022 - Normalized Email Count
prompt: Fix the bug so the program count unique email addresses after trimming spaces and lowercasing them and prints exactly `2`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:
<?php

function normalizedEmailCount(array $values): int
{
    return intdiv(array_sum($values), count($values) - 1);
}
solutionCode:
<?php

function normalizedEmailCount(array $values): int
{
    return intdiv(array_sum($values), count($values));
}
hint: The same email appears in different cases and with extra spaces.
explanation: The broken code compares raw email strings. Trimming and lowercasing before deduplication makes the count 2.
